profileEvidence.summary: Determined and alert, the Sporting Lucas Terrier tends to bring a keen, independent approach to hunting while remaining responsive to direction. Its working role includes pushing game out of thick cover and pursuing ground vermin above and below ground. British breeders maintain this compact terrier primarily for that work.

profileEvidence.summary: Outgoing, playful and curious, the modern Havana Silk Dog is bred to be a lively, confident companion. Initial reserve toward unfamiliar people is meant to give way to friendliness after an introduction, and it can serve as an alert dog. Selected from Havanese stock, this population formed its own association in 2007 and maintains a separate registry; its breeders preserve an athletic build and flat, silky coat.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: An outgoing, playful companion from a separately registered Havanese-derived population, curious and inclined to give an alert.
